manual.title: Connect to a Cactus Needle server
manual.description: Needle normalizes local Home Assistant commands and delegates everything else to your fallback agent.

on_supervisor.title: Install Cactus Needle
on_supervisor.description: Home Assistant can add the Cactus Needle App repository, install the App, and keep it running. This downloads the Cactus runtime and model to this Home Assistant system. Clear the option to connect to a server on another computer instead.

data.install_app: Automatically install and run the Cactus Needle App

install_app.title: Installing Cactus Needle
install_app.description: Home Assistant is adding the App repository, installing Cactus Needle, starting it, and waiting for the model to be ready. The first model download can take several minutes.

install_failed.title: Cactus Needle installation failed
install_failed.description: Home Assistant could not install or start the Cactus Needle App. Retry, or clear the option to connect to a server on another computer.

app_ready.title: Cactus Needle is ready
app_ready.description: Choose the conversation agent that should handle general questions and requests that are not Home Assistant device commands.

hassio_confirm.title: Set up {app}
hassio_confirm.description: Connect to the Cactus Needle Home Assistant App. Choose the agent that should handle general questions.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Cactus server
error.app_install_failed: Unable to install or start the Cactus Needle App

abort.already_configured: This Cactus server is already configured
abort.app_install_failed: The Cactus Needle App could not be installed or started

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Cactus server
